codebook.election: Election year, or "polls" for the Pooling the Poles snapshot
codebook.date: Election day, or the date of the poll estimate
codebook.source: PKW results (via Party tracker) or Pooling the Poles
codebook.lists_above_5: Lists with at least 5% of valid votes
codebook.enp_votes: Laakso–Taagepera effective number of parties, list vote shares
codebook.enp_seats: Laakso–Taagepera effective number of parties, list seat shares
codebook.golosov_votes: Golosov effective number of parties, vote shares
codebook.golosov_seats: Golosov effective number of parties, seat shares
codebook.n_largest: Inverse of the largest list's vote share
codebook.largest_vshare: Vote share of the largest list (proportion)
codebook.top2_vshare: Combined vote share of the two largest lists
codebook.margin_top2: Vote share of the largest list minus the second largest
codebook.fragmentation_rae: Rae fractionalisation of the vote, 1 minus the sum of squared shares
codebook.gallagher: Gallagher least-squares index (proportion; multiply by 100 for the usual scale)
codebook.wasted_votes: Vote share of lists that won no seats
codebook.largest_sshare: Seat share of the largest list by votes
codebook.seat_bonus: Seat share minus vote share of the largest list
codebook.volatility_total: Pedersen volatility on list lineages since the previous election (proportion)
codebook.volatility_type_a: Volatility from new and withdrawn lists (Powell and Tucker Type A), including lists with no party id, which are always new or withdrawn
codebook.volatility_between_family: Pedersen volatility between Party tracker's 14 party families, each list at the previous election taking the family of the list it continues into (a withdrawn list keeps its own)
codebook.volatility_between_family_plain: Pedersen volatility between party families, each list in its own family at both elections
codebook.volatility_within_family_plain: Vote moving between lineages of the same family, each list in its own family: the Pedersen index on lineage-by-family cells minus volatility_between_family_plain. The plain between and within sum to more than volatility_total where a lineage changes family, because its vote then counts as leaving one family and entering another
codebook.new_list_vshare: Vote share of lists with no predecessor at the previous election (the sum of the four new_ columns below)
codebook.new_genuine: Vote share of genuinely new lists
codebook.new_splinter: Vote share of new lists holding a party that stood at the previous election on a list that continues elsewhere, or a party born of a split from a party that stood at the previous election
codebook.new_returning: Vote share of new lists whose party stood before the previous election but not at it
codebook.new_unidentified: Vote share of lists with no party id in Party tracker
codebook.psns_constituency: Vote-weighted mean standardised party nationalisation score (Bochsler) of seat-winning lists, constituencies; for 1991, only the lists in the KBW file
codebook.psns_gmina: As psns_constituency, gminas as KBW reports them (Warsaw as one unit in 2005, as 7 to 18 districts or gminas in other years), without votes cast abroad or on ships
codebook.units_gmina: Number of gminas, Warsaw's units counted as KBW reports them
codebook.enp_district_mean: Mean constituency effective number of parties, weighted by valid votes (KBW constituency files)
codebook.enp_inflation: National ENP from the KBW constituency files over enp_district_mean, minus 1 (Moenius and Kasuya inflation)

captions.fig_effective_number_of_parties: Effective number of parties by votes and seats, Sejm elections 1991–2023, with the Pooling the Poles estimate for 24 October 2026 at the right (seats from its constituency projection). Laakso–Taagepera index on list shares.
captions.fig_disproportionality: Disproportionality, Sejm elections 1991–2023, with the poll-based projection (open circles): Gallagher least-squares index, the share of valid votes cast for lists that won no seats, and the largest list's seat share minus its vote share.
captions.fig_volatility: Electoral volatility, Sejm elections 1993–2023 (Pedersen index on list lineages). Top: new and withdrawn lists, including lists with no party id (Type A), and change among continuing lineages (Type B). Middle: change between Party tracker's 14 party families, each list at the earlier election taking the family of the list it continues into, and the remainder within them. Bottom: the vote for lists with no predecessor in the previous election.
captions.fig_nationalisation: Standardised party nationalisation scores (Bochsler 2010) by constituencies and gminas, Sejm elections 1991–2023, for the lists with at least 5% of the vote in the lineages named in the legend (AWS includes AWSP in 2001). Lists with at least 5% whose party has no colour in the shared palette are not shown: WAK, POC, KPN, KLD, PL, NSZZ „S” (1991); UP, KKW „Ojczyzna”, KPN, BBWR (1993); ROP (1997). The dashed line is the vote-weighted mean over all seat-winning lists.
captions.fig_polarisation: Ideological polarisation of the Polish party system by CHES wave (Dalton index, 0–10), weighted by list vote shares in the latest Sejm election in or before the wave year.
